verdict.rationale: The GitHub README documents an `x-proxy: auto` header that routes requests through Reader's hosted proxy pool, which rotates residential and datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically (API key required). Related controls, such as forwarding session cookies and forcing the headless-browser engine, add further help with hard-to-scrape sites. Missing for 10: an explicit option to choose residential vs. datacenter proxies or bring your own, detailed proxy documentation beyond a single README line, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the proxy actually defeats anti-bot defenses.
